candidate_rule: For each term, form offense_z times opponent defense_z on each team row, then form home minus away at the game row. The list is frozen from matchup_grid field names after metadata-only review of the undated 108-row archetype and 315-row position scheme tables. Those undated tables are not joined, fitted, or scored.
feature_availability: Every interaction is declared available at event_date T00:00:00; the scored state is event_date T12:00:00.
frozen_bar: Census first; all paired joined rows; model-relative ECE, Brier, log-loss with corpus_unit-clustered CI and n_eff; market-relative metrics only on pregame close rows; ten bins under np.linspace(0,1,11), [lo,hi) except final [lo,hi]; zero rows dropped after pairing.
interaction_model: Ridge logistic residual model with logit(p_base) fixed as a true offset. Standardization and the ridge fit use only evaluator-supplied training states. If fewer than 30 train rows are available, the callback returns p_base.
metric: ECE, Brier, and log-loss of callback-produced interaction predictions against the incumbent on all paired rows, and separately against p_close only where close_source is pregame_last_tick_before_commence.
seal_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialized with sort_keys=true and separators=(comma,colon), after removing seal_sha256.
verdict_rule: If fewer than 30 corpus-unit clusters remain after pairing, report CLOSED AT LIMIT. Otherwise report SCREEN NULL unless the required census, zero-drop, callback, purge, symmetric embargo, and archived paired-loss conditions are all met; no market-relative result is stated when the pregame close subset has fewer than 30 effective clusters.
